messages:
samira: Hey team — just got a ticket from Acme Inc. Their free trial credits were exhausted yesterday during an API outage + a failed billing retry. They say their CI retried on 5xx and ended up burning credits. Customer is asking for a credit extension or a promo. Ticket: https://support.redwood.ai/tickets/98765

maria: Thanks @samira — can you paste the account id and a short timeline? Any incident/deploy links?

samira: Account: acct_0A9Z7H. Timeline (UTC): 2026-11-22 14:02 API 5xx starts, 14:05–14:20 repeated CI retries, 14:21 deploy rollback. Status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/INC-20261122-4. Sample request ids from customer: req_33a4, req_33b0

maria: Copying in @kyle (finance) and @alex (product). Our standard trial policy: credits expire at trial end and are non-refundable, but we make exceptions for platform incidents. We need verification that usage/consumption happened during the outage window.

ops-bot: Incident INC-20261122-4: API gateway upstream errors (500/502) observed 14:02–14:24 UTC. Root cause: rate-limiter misconfiguration during deploy. Services recovered 14:25 UTC.

maria: Looks like platform incident aligns with customer's timeline. Proposed customer-facing resolution: offer a one-time credit equal to the tokens consumed during the outage window or issue an equivalent promo code + trial extension. Note: credits > $500 require finance approval.

kyle: @maria I pulled the billing report. Impacted usage flagged to acct_0A9Z7H is ~1.2M tokens (~$360). I approve a courtesy credit up to $500 for this case. No legal hold.

alex: @maria can we capture this pattern in a post-incident action? If customers retry aggressively on 5xx we should consider default retry/backoff guidance in our devex docs or an SDK change. Filing an internal PR.

maria: Thanks. @samira please respond to customer: offer $360 credit + 7 day trial extension OR a promo code if preferred. I'll prepare the wording.

maria (draft reply): "Hi — thanks for reporting this. We confirmed there was a platform incident during your test window that contributed to unexpected token consumption. We've issued a $360 account credit and extended your trial by 7 days; you should see the credit within 24 hours. If you'd rather have a promo code to distribute to your team, we can issue one instead. Apologies for the disruption and thanks for the logs — we'll follow up on retry/backoff guidance.

If you'd like the promo code, reply here and we'll issue it immediately.

— Maria, Redwood Support" :tada:

samira: Sent. Customer replied: prefers a promo code they can use across team, and asked product to note retry guidance. They attached CI logs and a short video.

maria: Promo code created and applied to the account; trial extended 7 days. Closing ticket after customer confirmation. Leaving incident note and tagging product for SDK guidance.

samira: Customer confirmed promo applied and is happy. Thanks all :pray:

kyle: Finance side closed. :white_check_mark:

maria: Marking case as exception granted and updating internal ticket: EXC-20261122-09.

samira: Closing thread.
